title: Ahbeesee defeegee kelomen opeecue rustyouvee doubleyou.

anchor.text: Ahbeesee defeegee kelomen opeecue rustyouvee doubleyou.
anchor.prefix: ten barrels of stuff. Say he got ten per cent off. O more. Ten. Fifteen. He passed Saint Joseph's National school. Brats' clamour. Windows open. Fresh air helps memory. Or a lilt.
